title: Active or passive trail?
instruction: Sort which trail you leave on purpose, and which appears without you writing anything.

items.why: You wrote it yourself, on purpose.

items.text: An advertising cookie from visiting an online shop
items.why: It was saved without you writing anything; a visit was enough.

items.text: A photo you upload to the club’s website
The list of pages you clicked on
items.why: It appears by itself as you move around the web.

items.text: The city a website recognises from your IP address
items.why: You didn’t enter anything, and the website knows.

items.text: A review of a game that you write
How long you looked at trainers in an online shop
items.why: Viewing time is measured without you knowing.

debrief: You see your active trail, because you make it yourself. The passive one appears quietly, from cookies and from where you click and how long you look.
